title: Corpse Run, Part 3
description: Corpse Run, Part 3 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Jerome's Bones

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Kill enemies in Upper Shadow's Embrace until you find his necklace and two rings with Jerome Lester's name on them. Return with them to Jerome in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Jerome's Bones

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Corpse Run, Part 3-and-then-some

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill enemies in Upper Shadow's Embrace until you find his necklace and two rings with Jerome Lester's name on them. Return with them to Jerome in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

I tell ya, this is humiliatin'. What does a corpse have to do t' get his life back!?

Okay, let's think fer a sec. By now, my corpses have been looted a hunnert ways t' Sunday. Let's try this: Go through Upper Shadow's Embrace an' kill Oroks, Mutants...whatever's there. Some of those dirty dogs gots my stuff, and when you find my necklace and two rings, bring 'em back to me. Then I'll have everything I wore when running dungeons and I'll come back t' life fer sure!

Turn-in:

Kid, you take forever t' turn in quests. I'm just sayin'.

Whatcha got there? Another piece of my gear, eh? Let's try it...am I alive yet? No? Dagnabbit!

Objectives:

  • Jerome Lester's Necklace ×1
  • Jerome Lester's Ring ×1
  • Jerome Lester's Other Ring ×1

Client level range: 45–100
